# Overview

This notebook demonstrates the workflow used to:

1. generate a PROSAIL look-up table;
2. resample simulated spectra to the multispectral sensor bands;
3. retrieve LAI, Cab, and LIDFa from a UAS raster.

The full multi-date workflow is implemented in:

```text
R/04_run_all_dates.R
```

# Configuration

Edit:

```text
config/config.yml
```

to specify the campaign rasters, output directories, sensor response, and
processing settings.

# Run the complete workflow

```{r eval=FALSE}
source("../R/04_run_all_dates.R")
```

# Notes

The repository does not distribute the full UAS imagery. Users should provide
their own reflectance rasters with the expected five-band order.
